environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but with ingress-layer mutual TLS enforcement via an Istio sidecar proxy configured with PeerAuthentication in STRICT mode on the data-platform namespace. The Kafka broker's Envoy sidecar requires a valid client certificate issued by the internal mesh CA (istiod) with a SPIFFE identity matching 'spiffe://cluster.local/ns/data-platform/sa/authorized-producer'. Additionally, an AuthorizationPolicy resource restricts traffic to the Kafka broker port 9092 to only principals with the service account 'authorized-producer'. The stream processor itself runs with ENABLE_SHELL_HOOKS=true (unchanged). The processor pod's service account is 'stream-processor-sa' which IS authorized to consume but external/rogue pods cannot produce to the topic because they lack the required SPIFFE identity. Note: the Istio PeerAuthentication STRICT mode means plaintext connections are rejected at the Envoy proxy level before reaching Kafka.

config.kafka_auth: SASL/PLAIN with shared credentials in ConfigMap
